# 2 Baruch Chapter 26 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Second Fast and Dialogue

---

**1** I asked, "Will that tribulation go on for a long time? Will that distress hold the world in its grip for many years?"

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic rendering. A one-verse chapter — Baruch's urgent follow-up question. He has heard about the great tribulation; now he wants to know how long it will last. The answer in ch. 27 is the famous twelve woes.*
